snippet.title: Longplay of Project Gaiaray
snippet.description:
Longplay of Project Gaiaray, played with the NTSC-J version on the PlayStation. This game's version was released on Oct. 23rd 1997. Tell us what you think by leaving a comment down below!

00:00 - Opening
03:06 - Arcade Mode as Audace
13:44 - Final Boss 1
15:36 - Final Boss 2
17:43 - Ending & Credits
24:04 - Eye Catch

By: nikodem123asdf
